title: Lenna (standard test image)
summary: The standard 512×512 Lenna test image, cropped from a 1972 Playboy centerfold
description: The standard Lenna test image, cropped and scanned from Lena Forsén's November 1972 Playboy centerfold photograph by Dwight Hooker. First digitized at the University of Southern California in 1973, it became the most widely used test image in digital image processing.
